page.layout: One page of running text in one full-width column, with a small table of year, cycle and feria columns printed at the foot. No margin notes. The section letter "b" stands at the start of the second paragraph. Running head at top: ANNORVM. Page number 509 at top right.

main_text.p: & 14 scrupulo librae: quemadmodum post decenium, anno scilicet Christi 1525, Copernicus in Friburgo latitudinem habente 54 grad. & 19 ½ minutorum, eandem Spicam Virginis observauit in meridiano, cùm supra horizontem eleuata esset proximè ad 27 gradus: ex quo collegit declinationem eius ab æquinoctiali fuisse grad. 8, & 40 minutorum: vt videre licet lib.3 Reuolutionum cap.2.

bHoc anno Christi 1522, quinto kal. Octobris, quinque horis æqualibus, & duabus tertiis à meridie trâsactis circa solis occasum, Friburgi, per instrumentum parallacticum Copernicus observauit lunæ centrum in meridiano distare à vertice horizontis grad. LXX XII, scrupulo I[?], quemadmodum testatur lib.4 Reuolutionum cap.16. Vult autem à principio annorum Christi vsque ad hoc observationis tempus præteriisse annos Ægyptios, mille quingentos & viginti duos, item dies cclxxxiiii. Si ergo adiiciamus annos Ægyptios 747, & 131 dies, quos à Nabonasaro vsque ad epocham Christi elapsos esse probauimus, constantur anni Nabonasari 2270 & 50 dies, qui præterierùt ad observationem Copernici: etenim annus Nabonasari 2271 incipit die 8 Augusti, feria sexta, labente anno Christi 1522: quamobrem si hinc numerentur dies absoluti 50, descenditur ad 17 Septembris exclusiuè sumtam, quæ fuit quinta kal. Octob. ex quo intelligitur observationem Copernici incurrisse in diem 21 mensis Paophi, labente anno Nabonasari 2271.
main_text.l: Indict. | An.Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabon. Feriae. | Christi.

page.notes: The Roman numeral "LXX XII" is printed with a space and the scruple value after it reads as "I" or "1"; marked [?]. The fraction in "19 ½" is printed as a small glyph and read with some doubt. The "—1 Aug." mark in the table stands beside the row 6 Nabonassar feria and is placed in that cell; its exact position in print is uncertain. The table's column headers are abbreviated as printed ("Indiû." read as Indict.; "Ferix." read as Feriae.). Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
